newsitem.title: USA: US Midco spot prods mixed in pre-weekend trade.
newsitem.headline: US Midco spot prods mixed in pre-weekend trade.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot refined product prices were mixed late Friday, with trade turning thin ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Group prompt gasoline prices firmed in line with January NYMEX values, which got a lift from reports of tighter U.S. crude and distillate stocks.
Prompt prices for Group Three unleaded were assessed between 3.25 to 3.00 cents under January NYMEX, with later deliveries at parity.
Outright prices for group unleaded rose to 66.49/66.74 cents a barrel
Traders also quoted first cycle January barrels at 5.00 below NYMEX.
Chicago spot prices fell, with markets seen amply stocked and forecasters predicting mild temperatures for the short-term.
Low sulphur diesel in Chicago was traded slightly lower between 6.00 and 5.50 cents under February NYMEX heating oil.
Unleaded gasoline in Chicago also weakened, with diffs lower at 4.00 to 3.50 cents under the screen and NYMEX February unleaded up 0.28 cents on bullish inventory data.
